en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Hasan bin Ali al-Washhaa’, from Ali bin Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, that he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, about: « the male attendants with no carnality» [24:31]. He said: It is the dumb, the imposed, who does not (sexually) approach women.
